fix.note: 辛苦晒 = thanks for all your hard work.

ex.en: I drink coffee every day.

notes: Readings all verified; dictionary CHECKs are correct colloquial readings. Fixed unnatural sentences: 個胃有啲辛苦, 比賽跑咗第二, and 一係就 misused as 'otherwise' (that is 唔係就).
